scope: Classical Y state at 0.2 T, J = 0.075 meV, J_z = 0.125 meV, S = 1/2, J_Gamma = 0; full-sphere relaxations and classical harmonic fluctuations; no quantum angular potential, no anharmonic or quantum free energy. Lengths in bond lengths a.
conventions: Three forward walls on a torus of L x W magnetic cells (axis 0 of nbcp_y_density_wall). The pair sits in the middle domain; distance from the centre of the wall between layers L/3 - 1 and L/3; order +1 puts the +1 core first along the wall. Cores held by a ring 1.8 < r < 3.2 with penalty lambda/2 |n_perp - target|^2 and a free rotation per core.
